nodes.en: film.html: tracks of clips; each shot a page with frame(t)
nodes.zh: film.html：轨道与片段；每个镜头是带 frame(t) 的网页

nodes.en: Host freezes time, random and animations at t
nodes.zh: 宿主把时间、随机数与动画钉在 t

nodes.en: look draws frames twice in shuffled orders and compares
nodes.zh: look 按两种乱序各画一遍并比对

nodes.en: Up to 4 browsers render frames, ffmpeg encodes MP4
nodes.zh: 最多 4 个浏览器并发出帧，ffmpeg 编码 MP4

nodes.en: Person edits in Studio, saved as clip overrides
nodes.zh: 人在 Studio 手改，存为片段 overrides

nodes.en: Agent rewrites film.html with its own file tools
nodes.zh: agent 用自己的文件工具重写 film.html

nodes.en: Three-way merge per clip and field; person wins conflicts
nodes.zh: 按片段与字段三方合并；冲突时人的值胜出

nodes.en: Agent told what was kept; both versions saved in history
nodes.zh: 告诉 agent 保留了什么；两版都存进历史

edges.zh: 同一 t 同一画面
